summary: October 16, 2026 source 3.6.0 evidence recalibration. Preserve separate Orchestra, standalone Agent, local Mesh and browser/native-journal achievements. Named installed, authenticated multi-host, host-power-loss and sustained-load obligations cannot be closed by unrelated historical operational claims. This is retained-evidence review, not new product execution or automatic recovery authorization.

qualification_requirements.acceptance: Preserve the retained two-host Orchestra loss/re-registration journey with its original Agent process and version. It does not qualify decentralized discovery, current installed typed workflows or raw Agent ingress authentication.

Retain actual local native Agent process-kill, ledger reopen, original-owner inspect/cancel, unknown-outcome no-replay and healthy next-task evidence. SIGKILL is not host power loss; a durable admission without a receipt is not a completed computation.

Retain native local peer discovery, peer loss/rejoin, same-endpoint ledger replacement and cancellation-reply-loss checks with no cross-peer replay. A cluster name or store ID is not authentication, consensus, durable distributed DAG ownership or task migration.

Preserve local caller identity, authority retirement, exact-owner recovery and conditional cleanup. Browser HTTP responses are mocked and native journal process tests are a separate layer, not one installed GUI-to-real-Agent journey.

Retain source browser/PWDT reservation mismatch rejection before POST, immutable metadata, authority checks and abortable conditional cleanup with original-ID explicit retry. Mocked checkpoint responses do not qualify installed, cross-window atomicity or power-loss behavior.

Retain real iframe navigation and bounded session/queue retirement with mocked native invocation. Delayed requests cannot cross document ownership, but native calls already dispatched may commit. This is not installed WebView or actual BFCache qualification.

Retain bounded real source Orchestra/Agent restart chains through isolated remote PostgreSQL JSONB, typed identity and unknown-receipt blocking. The test pool warm-up, macOS compute and seven small rounds do not qualify default-policy installed Linux execution, PWDT revision-two migration or arbitrary DAG depth.

Qualify authenticated peer/controller identity, admission and recovery authorization, revocation and replay rejection on the native Agent listener. Cover one-Orchestra binding and mutually exclusive offline Mesh authority. Trusted-network raw TCP, public cluster/store IDs, HTTP gateway auth and connection limits cannot substitute.

Retain repeated real multi-host Mesh partition/rejoin, endpoint/ledger replacement and lost-reply recovery with authenticated peers, original-owner fencing and healthy distinct tasks. Unknown work must not migrate or replay. Loopback Agents and Orchestra re-registration are different scopes; this does not implicitly certify distributed DAG scheduling.

Exercise the matching installed shell/frontend/native journal against a real durable Agent. Include lost admission/cancel replies, App kill/reopen, two-window conditional cleanup, same-endpoint foreign ledger rejection and healthy follow-up without new identity or blind replay. Separate browser mocks and filesystem unit tests are not the complete journey.

On disposable owned storage, retain non-graceful host or VM power-cut evidence around store identity, admission, result and directory-sync boundaries; committed receipts survive, incomplete outcomes stay unknown, corrupt records fail closed and a fresh task succeeds. Process kill, file-sync calls alone and another service's old host-reset evidence do not close this scope. No production data is a fault-test target.

Through Installer-managed matching runtime artifacts and default database policy, qualify typed solve/branch/join continuation with a remote native Agent, ownership takeover and final publication after faults. Completed work is not repeated; lost native evidence blocks rather than fabricating completion. Older operational takeover and source-only typed tests retain their scopes, not current installed acceptance.

Measure repeated sustained connection/byte saturation, peer churn and recovery traffic on real multi-host Agents. Retain tail latency, throughput, memory/descriptor ceilings, recovery capacity and healthy next tasks. The 64-candidate cap, thousand-round state test and historical 1M solver-node runs are not this benchmark; do not increase limits to pass.
